points.why: Step 1 says each group defends its own worldview and would define the problem and success differently, so the district would 'argue forever'.
It collects each group's problem statement and interviews families and students, but separately rather than as a shared picture of the system built together in one room.
It treats the causes as interacting reinforcing loops and questions key assumptions, such as what transportation measures and the blame in the principals' parent story.
It doesn't track who has been consulted, and it moves to data analysis on every claim without first agreeing the definitions.

pitfalls.why: It explicitly rejects picking one cause and recommends a diagnostic sprint and a staged bundle.
